Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Fri, Nov 6 7:34am to 6:17pm; Sat, Nov 7 7:36am to 6:16pm; Sun, Nov 8 7:37am to 6:14pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Fri, Nov 6 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Gale day in the Strait. At 5am Sand Heads reads E 20 and Halibut Bank ENE 23 gusting 28: right on size, still more east than the page's SE. Environment Canada has southeast 35 this morning, easing to 20 to 30 by noon.

My pick is Boundary Bay from noon to 5:30pm, SSE 20 to 24 gusting 30. You need 10ft of tide, so not before noon (high 13.6ft at 3:47pm). Advanced riders: Tsawwassen south side, 22 to 28 with 2ft waves. Go if Sand Heads has swung SE by 11am.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PCT 06 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Saturday. Gale warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 5 to 15 knots increasing to southerly inflow 15 to 25 early this evening then diminishing to light late this evening. Wind increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 late overnight and to northerly outflow 25 to 35 Saturday morning. Wind becoming southerly inflow 25 to 35 Saturday afternoon.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PCT 06 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Saturday. Gale warning in effect. Wind southeast 20 to 30 knots diminishing to south 10 to 20 early this evening then backing to east 15 to 20 Saturday morning. Wind increasing to southeast 20 to 30 Saturday afternoon then becoming southeast 25 to 35 Saturday evening.
